USAGE:
  sediment report dataset-diagnostics [-h] [--org ORG] [--json]
                                      [--dpo-recipe {dpo_human,dpo_outcome}]
                                      [--sft-recipe {sft_curated,sft_verified}]
                                      [--max-examples MAX_EXAMPLES]
                                      [--dpo-near-duplicate-threshold DPO_NEAR_DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD]
                                      [--database-url DATABASE_URL]
                                      [--mirror-path MIRROR_PATH]

  DPO/SFT dataset diagnostics.

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --org ORG             org id (default: $SEDIMENT_ORG_ID)
  --json                emit JSON report instead of tables
  --dpo-recipe {dpo_human,dpo_outcome}
                        DPO evidence recipe (default: dpo_human)
  --sft-recipe {sft_curated,sft_verified}
                        SFT evidence recipe (default: sft_curated)
  --max-examples MAX_EXAMPLES
                        maximum examples per diagnostics section (default: 5)
  --dpo-near-duplicate-threshold DPO_NEAR_DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD
                        minimum token Jaccard similarity for DPO near-duplicate
                        prompt bucket flags (default: 0.8)
  --database-url DATABASE_URL
                        PostgreSQL URL (default: $SEDIMENT_DATABASE_URL)
  --mirror-path MIRROR_PATH
                        base dir for git mirrors (default: $SEDIMENT_MIRROR_PATH
                        or './mirrors')
